tools.name: inventorymod_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses (stock locations) of the workspace. Use a warehouse id in the stock tools. GET /api/rpc/warehouses/list.

tools.name: inventorymod_list_categories
tools.description: List the product categories of the workspace. GET /api/rpc/categories/list.

tools.name: inventorymod_search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog with filters, stock status and sorting. Returns items and totalCount. GET /api/rpc/products/search.

tools.name: inventorymod_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its id. GET /api/rpc/products/get.

tools.name: inventorymod_find_product
tools.description: Find one product by its SKU or barcode. GET /api/rpc/products/getByCode.

tools.name: inventorymod_get_product_stock
tools.description: Get the stock of one product in one warehouse: quantity, reserved and available. GET /api/rpc/balances/get.

tools.name: inventorymod_search_stock_balances
tools.description: Search stock balances per product and warehouse, with stock status filter and sorting. GET /api/rpc/balances/page.

tools.name: inventorymod_get_warehouse_totals
tools.description: Get the total physical stock per warehouse. GET /api/rpc/balances/warehouseTotals.

tools.name: inventorymod_search_movements
tools.description: Search the stock movement history (receipts, issues, adjustments, transfers) with filters. GET /api/rpc/movements/page.

tools.name: inventorymod_search_sales_orders
tools.description: Search the sales orders with a search text and status filter. GET /api/rpc/orders/search.

tools.name: inventorymod_get_sales_order
tools.description: Get one sales order with its lines. GET /api/rpc/orders/get.

tools.name: inventorymod_search_purchase_orders
tools.description: Search the purchase orders by number and status. GET /api/rpc/purchaseOrders/search.

tools.name: inventorymod_get_dashboard_summary
tools.description: Get the dashboard summary: product count, stock value, out-of-stock and low-stock items, and totals by category and warehouse. GET /api/rpc/reports/dashboard.

tools.name: inventorymod_create_product
tools.description: Create a product in the catalog (needs a write key). Writes a new product; it does not change stock. POST /api/rpc/products/create.

tools.name: inventorymod_update_product
tools.description: Change the fields of one product (needs a write key). Only the fields you pass change. The kind is not changed here. POST /api/rpc/products/update.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: inventorymod_search_movements · Public sink: inventorymod_create_product, inventorymod_update_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: inventorymod_search_movements · Public sink: inventorymod_create_product, inventorymod_update_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
